svg.text: List pending surveys scoped to PM's projects
Validate JWT + guard: cannot approve own survey
Guard: status must be approved or rejected
- Survey Engineer approves own submission: 403 Forbidden
- Approve while processing incomplete or failed:
- Archive a survey still pending_approval: 400 INVALID_STATE
- Approve/Reject a survey not pending_approval: 409 CONFLICT
- Approvals Module owns state transitions for review;
Surveys Module remains source of truth for readiness
- Every approval action writes an immutable
- Audit Module call is synchronous, so no approval
- Access Control Module enforces the 'cannot approve own
survey' guard before Approvals Module is even called
- Dashed orange box: Drone Mapping Service boundary
- Colored modules inside the box are internal
